---
title: "05 - Build the 3D soma target"
author: "Xinyi Chen"
output: html_document
---

# Purpose

This file prepares the inputs for the Python reconstruction.
It defines a fixed three-dimensional soma target, crops a
soma-centered region of interest (ROI), and exports the signal
volume, soma target, raw-image projection, and coordinate metadata.

The same exported inputs are used for active-threshold selection
and final reconstruction. Manual tracing is loaded for visual
quality control only; it does not define the soma target or ROI.

# When to run

Run this file before Step06 and Step07 to generate their inputs.
Rerun it if the input images, selected soma, target settings,
or ROI settings change. Otherwise, the existing exports can be reused.

# Steps

## Step 1 — Specify the input files and target settings

Select the sample, raw image, MGtoolbox signal, Cellpose label
image, and manual tracing. Specify the Cellpose label identifying
the soma, an XY cylinder radius of 18 pixels, and a target-signal
percentile of 99%.

## Step 2 — Read and check the image data

Load the raw three-dimensional image, MGtoolbox signal volume,
and two-dimensional Cellpose labels. Normalize the signal by
its maximum value, restore the integer Cellpose label IDs,
and check that the XY image dimensions agree.

## Step 3 — Read the manual tracing

Read the tracing paths and their three-dimensional coordinates.
Keep the paths separate so they can be displayed correctly
during visual quality control.

## Step 4 — Locate the selected soma

Identify the pixels belonging to the selected Cellpose label
and calculate their mean XY position. Convert this position
to zero-based image coordinates for use in the exported metadata.

## Step 5 — Define the soma-centered candidate cylinder

Construct a disk with an 18-pixel radius around the soma center
and extend it through all Z slices. This cylinder limits the
region from which the three-dimensional soma target is selected.

## Step 6 — Define the fixed three-dimensional soma target

Calculate the 99th percentile of signal values within the
cylinder. Retain cylinder voxels whose signal is at or above
this value.

This target remains fixed when different active thresholds
are tested later.

## Step 7 — Check target and tracing alignment

Display full-image and zoomed maximum-intensity projections
of the raw image and normalized signal. Overlay the manual
tracing, selected Cellpose label, candidate disk, and projected
three-dimensional target.

Use these views to check their spatial alignment before export.

## Step 8 — Crop and export the reconstruction inputs

Define an XY ROI extending 120 pixels from the soma center,
clipped to the image boundaries, and retain all Z slices.

Export the cropped signal volume, soma target, and raw-image
MIP as binary files. Save the array dimensions, storage order,
ROI offsets, soma coordinates, and target settings in
`roi_metadata.csv`.

These files allow Python to read the arrays and map local
ROI coordinates back to the original image.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(MGtoolbox)
library(tiff)
library(xml2)
```

## 1. Input

```{r input}
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

  repeat {
    has_readme <- file.exists(file.path(current, "README.md"))
    has_notebooks <- dir.exists(file.path(current, "notebooks"))
    has_data <- dir.exists(file.path(current, "data"))

    if (has_readme && has_notebooks && has_data) {
      return(current)
    }

    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("Open this file from within the repository containing README.md, notebooks/, and data/.")
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()

# Display exported paths relative to the repository root.
project_relative <- function(path) {
  prefix <- paste0(project_root, "/")

  if (!startsWith(path, prefix)) {
    stop("The path is outside the repository.")
  }

  substring(path, nchar(prefix) + 1L)
}

sample_name <- "p28_330_HET_009"
cellpose_label <- 25L
soma_radius_xy <- 18
target_quantile <- 0.99

raw_dir <- file.path(
  project_root, "data", sample_name, "raw"
)
raw_file <- paste0(sample_name, ".tif")

probability_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "results", sample_name, "01_mgtoolbox_signal",
  paste0(sample_name, "_mg_probability_3d.rds")
)

cellpose_mask_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "data", sample_name, "cellpose",
  "p28_330_HET_009_2D_projection_masks.tif"
)

trace_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "data", sample_name, "manual_tracing",
  "p28_330_HET_009_manual.traces"
)
```

## 2. Read the inputs

```{r read-inputs}
stack_list <- read_z_stacks(
  dir = raw_dir,
  filename = raw_file
)
raw_stack <- stack_list[[raw_file]]

mg_probability_3d <- readRDS(probability_file)
mg_probability_3d <- mg_probability_3d /
  max(mg_probability_3d, na.rm = TRUE)

cellpose_labels_scaled <- readTIFF(
  cellpose_mask_file,
  native = FALSE,
  convert = FALSE
)

# tiff::readTIFF() represents this uint16 label image on a 0-1 scale.
# Restore the original integer label IDs (0 through 44).
cellpose_labels <- round(cellpose_labels_scaled * 65535)
rm(cellpose_labels_scaled)

cat("Cellpose label range:", range(cellpose_labels), "\n")
cat("Pixels in requested label:", sum(cellpose_labels == cellpose_label), "\n")

if (!identical(dim(cellpose_labels), dim(mg_probability_3d)[1:2])) {
  stop(
    "Cellpose mask dimensions do not match the MG probability XY dimensions."
  )
}

cat("Raw dimensions:", paste(dim(raw_stack), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("MG dimensions:", paste(dim(mg_probability_3d), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Cellpose dimensions:", paste(dim(cellpose_labels), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

## 3. Read the manual tracing

```{r read-tracing}
trace_xml_text <- paste(
  readLines(gzfile(trace_file), warn = FALSE),
  collapse = "\n"
)

trace_document <- read_xml(trace_xml_text)
trace_path_nodes <- xml_find_all(trace_document, "//path")

trace_paths <- lapply(seq_along(trace_path_nodes), function(path_id) {
  point_nodes <- xml_find_all(trace_path_nodes[[path_id]], ".//point")

  data.frame(
    path_id = path_id,
    x = as.numeric(xml_attr(point_nodes, "x")),
    y = as.numeric(xml_attr(point_nodes, "y")),
    z = as.numeric(xml_attr(point_nodes, "z"))
  )
})

trace_points <- do.call(rbind, trace_paths)

cat("Tracing paths:", length(trace_paths), "\n")
cat("Tracing points:", nrow(trace_points), "\n")
```

## 4. Find the Cellpose soma center

```{r cellpose-center}
cellpose_soma <- cellpose_labels == cellpose_label

if (!any(cellpose_soma)) {
  stop("Cellpose label ", cellpose_label, " was not found.")
}

soma_pixels <- which(cellpose_soma, arr.ind = TRUE)

# Matrix rows are Y coordinates and columns are X coordinates.
soma_center_y <- mean(soma_pixels[, "row"]) - 1
soma_center_x <- mean(soma_pixels[, "col"]) - 1

cat("Cellpose label:", cellpose_label, "\n")
cat("Soma center X:", soma_center_x, "\n")
cat("Soma center Y:", soma_center_y, "\n")
```

## 5. Build the XY disk and 3D candidate cylinder

```{r candidate-cylinder}
y_coordinates <- 0:(nrow(cellpose_labels) - 1)
x_coordinates <- 0:(ncol(cellpose_labels) - 1)

soma_disk_xy <- outer(
  y_coordinates,
  x_coordinates,
  function(y, x) {
    (x - soma_center_x)^2 + (y - soma_center_y)^2 <= soma_radius_xy^2
  }
)

soma_candidate_3d <- array(
  rep(soma_disk_xy, dim(mg_probability_3d)[3]),
  dim = dim(mg_probability_3d)
)

cat("XY disk pixels:", sum(soma_disk_xy), "\n")
cat("3D candidate-cylinder voxels:", sum(soma_candidate_3d), "\n")
```

## 6. Keep the brightest 1% as the fixed 3D target

```{r build-target}
candidate_values <- mg_probability_3d[soma_candidate_3d]

target_probability_cutoff <- quantile(
  candidate_values,
  probs = target_quantile,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  names = FALSE
)

soma_target_3d <-
  soma_candidate_3d &
  mg_probability_3d >= target_probability_cutoff

cat("Target quantile:", target_quantile, "\n")
cat("Target probability cutoff:", target_probability_cutoff, "\n")
cat("3D target voxels:", sum(soma_target_3d), "\n")
cat("Target Z range (zero-based):")

target_indices <- which(soma_target_3d, arr.ind = TRUE)
print(range(target_indices[, 3] - 1))
```

## 7. Display the target QC with the manual tracing

```{r target-qc}
raw_mip <- apply(raw_stack, c(1, 2), max, na.rm = TRUE)
mg_mip <- apply(mg_probability_3d, c(1, 2), max, na.rm = TRUE)
target_mip <- apply(soma_target_3d, c(1, 2), any)

normalize_for_display <- function(image_matrix) {
  display_limits <- quantile(
    image_matrix,
    probs = c(0.01, 0.998),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  displayed <- (image_matrix - display_limits[1]) /
    (display_limits[2] - display_limits[1])

  pmin(pmax(displayed, 0), 1)
}

plot_image <- function(
  image_matrix,
  title_text,
  x_limits = c(0, ncol(image_matrix) - 1),
  y_limits = c(nrow(image_matrix) - 1, 0)
) {
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = x_limits,
    ylim = y_limits,
    asp = 1,
    axes = FALSE,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    main = title_text
  )

  rasterImage(
    as.raster(normalize_for_display(image_matrix)),
    xleft = 0,
    ybottom = nrow(image_matrix) - 1,
    xright = ncol(image_matrix) - 1,
    ytop = 0,
    interpolate = FALSE
  )
}

add_trace <- function(paths, color = "magenta", line_width = 1.2) {
  for (one_path in paths) {
    if (nrow(one_path) == 1) {
      points(one_path$x, one_path$y, col = color, pch = 16, cex = 0.3)
    } else {
      lines(one_path$x, one_path$y, col = color, lwd = line_width)
    }
  }
}

add_target_overlays <- function() {
  contour(
    x = 0:(ncol(cellpose_soma) - 1),
    y = 0:(nrow(cellpose_soma) - 1),
    z = t(cellpose_soma),
    levels = 0.5,
    add = TRUE,
    drawlabels = FALSE,
    col = "cyan",
    lwd = 1.5
  )
  contour(
    x = 0:(ncol(soma_disk_xy) - 1),
    y = 0:(nrow(soma_disk_xy) - 1),
    z = t(soma_disk_xy),
    levels = 0.5,
    add = TRUE,
    drawlabels = FALSE,
    col = "yellow",
    lwd = 1.2
  )
  contour(
    x = 0:(ncol(target_mip) - 1),
    y = 0:(nrow(target_mip) - 1),
    z = t(target_mip),
    levels = 0.5,
    add = TRUE,
    drawlabels = FALSE,
    col = "red",
    lwd = 1.5
  )
  add_trace(trace_paths)
}

zoom_radius <- 90
zoom_x <- c(
  max(0, soma_center_x - zoom_radius),
  min(ncol(raw_mip) - 1, soma_center_x + zoom_radius)
)
zoom_y <- c(
  min(nrow(raw_mip) - 1, soma_center_y + zoom_radius),
  max(0, soma_center_y - zoom_radius)
)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

plot_image(raw_mip, "Raw MIP: full field")
add_target_overlays()

plot_image(raw_mip, "Raw MIP: target and tracing zoom", zoom_x, zoom_y)
add_target_overlays()

plot_image(mg_mip, "MG probability MIP: full field")
add_target_overlays()

plot_image(mg_mip, "MG probability MIP: target and tracing zoom", zoom_x, zoom_y)
add_target_overlays()
```

QC colors: magenta is the manual tracing, cyan is Cellpose label 25, yellow is
the radius-18 XY disk, and red is the Z-projected fixed 3D target.

## 8. Export the approved target ROI for the next calculation

Run this cell only after the target QC above is correct. These are working
inputs for the active-threshold sweep and are saved in
`results/p28_330_HET_009/3d/intermediate/`.

```{r export-approved-target-roi}
roi_radius_xy <- 120L

roi_y0 <- max(0L, floor(soma_center_y) - roi_radius_xy)
roi_y1 <- min(nrow(mg_probability_3d) - 1L, floor(soma_center_y) + roi_radius_xy)
roi_x0 <- max(0L, floor(soma_center_x) - roi_radius_xy)
roi_x1 <- min(ncol(mg_probability_3d) - 1L, floor(soma_center_x) + roi_radius_xy)

roi_y_indices <- (roi_y0:roi_y1) + 1L
roi_x_indices <- (roi_x0:roi_x1) + 1L

mg_probability_roi <- mg_probability_3d[
  roi_y_indices,
  roi_x_indices,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

soma_target_roi <- soma_target_3d[
  roi_y_indices,
  roi_x_indices,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

raw_mip_roi <- raw_mip[
  roi_y_indices,
  roi_x_indices,
  drop = FALSE
]

working_directory <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "results", sample_name, "3d", "intermediate"
)
dir.create(working_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_float32 <- function(values, output_file) {
  connection <- file(output_file, open = "wb")
  on.exit(close(connection), add = TRUE)
  writeBin(
    as.numeric(values),
    connection,
    size = 4L,
    endian = "little"
  )
}

write_uint8 <- function(values, output_file) {
  connection <- file(output_file, open = "wb")
  on.exit(close(connection), add = TRUE)
  writeBin(
    as.integer(values),
    connection,
    size = 1L,
    endian = "little"
  )
}

write_float32(
  mg_probability_roi,
  file.path(working_directory, "mg_probability_roi_yxz_float32.bin")
)

write_uint8(
  soma_target_roi,
  file.path(working_directory, "soma_target_roi_yxz_uint8.bin")
)

write_float32(
  raw_mip_roi,
  file.path(working_directory, "raw_mip_roi_yx_float32.bin")
)

roi_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_name,
  cellpose_label = cellpose_label,
  array_order = "R column-major Y,X,Z",
  dim_y = dim(mg_probability_roi)[1],
  dim_x = dim(mg_probability_roi)[2],
  dim_z = dim(mg_probability_roi)[3],
  global_y0_zero_based = roi_y0,
  global_y1_zero_based = roi_y1,
  global_x0_zero_based = roi_x0,
  global_x1_zero_based = roi_x1,
  soma_center_y_global = soma_center_y,
  soma_center_x_global = soma_center_x,
  soma_center_y_local = soma_center_y - roi_y0,
  soma_center_x_local = soma_center_x - roi_x0,
  soma_radius_xy = soma_radius_xy,
  target_quantile = target_quantile,
  target_probability_cutoff = target_probability_cutoff,
  target_voxels = sum(soma_target_roi)
)

write.csv(
  roi_metadata,
  file.path(working_directory, "roi_metadata.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Exported working ROI to:\n", project_relative(working_directory), "\n", sep = "")
print(roi_metadata)
```
